company.name: Corgea
company.shortDescription: Corgea is a network management software that monitors data traffic and secures sensitive data for businesses.
company.description: Corgea develops data privacy and security solutions enabling companies to easily identify, track, and secure sensitive data. The solution also helps companies ensure that they comply with relevant regulations and standards, such as GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered application security platform that performs static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), secrets scanning, malware scanning, PII/PHI scanning, and auto-triage to detect and fix vulnerabilities in code.
productsAndServices.name: Corgea AppSec Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI-enhanced environment for creating, testing, and optimizing security policies using natural language and YAML, enabling precise vulnerability detection and false positive reduction.
productsAndServices.name: Policy Playground and Policy Optimizer

productsAndServices.description: A GitHub integration that automatically scans pull requests for vulnerabilities and suggests fixes, streamlining secure code review and remediation.
productsAndServices.name: Corgea GitHub App

productsAndServices.description: Integration capabilities that connect Corgea’s AI-driven security analysis and remediation with established SAST tools like Fortify, Snyk, Checkmarx, Semgrep, and CodeQL.
productsAndServices.name: Integration with Fortify and Other SAST Tools

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven feature that reduces false positives in static code analysis by understanding code context, framework specifics, and usage patterns.
productsAndServices.name: Advanced False Positive Detection
